title: Advancements Challenge Mod
description: This project adds a challenge into minecraft 1.20.4 through 1.20.6, this mod puts you in a chunk sized barrier and everytime you get a achievement it expands and once you get all the achievements it will be a normal sized minecraft world! Enjoy This Mod!
body: This mod is a cool way to have fun and challenge yourself! With this mod you have to get advancements and you spawn in a small world border the size of a chunk, and every advancement expands the border. Have Fun!
